notes: CD5024 is the Zero+ Client variant with an integrated PKI-approved CAC/smart card reader (CD5022 is the same unit without it) — the smart card slot itself is not included as a port since it's not a signal/power connector on the given list. Datasheet text lists "Mic+Speaker 3.5mm" as one spec line but the front-panel photo shows two separate icons/jacks (mic and speaker), so they are listed as separate input/output 3.5mm TRS jacks. One additional internal-only USB 2.0 port exists per the datasheet but is omitted here since it is not externally accessible. Desktop/VESA-mount unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Also cross-checked against the product page at https://clearcube.com/products/zero-clients/zero/zero-client-cd5022-24-zero-plus/, which corroborates all port counts.

ports.name: DisplayPort 1

ports.name: DisplayPort 2
